description: Import a bank statement file into Ekylibre. A file named 'bank_import.ofx' is located in '/home/ga/Documents/'. This file contains recent transactions for the farm. Navigate to the 'Bank Statements' (Relevés bancaires) section, use the Import function to upload this file, and map it to the farm's main bank account (e.g., 'Banque' or 'Compte Courant'). Verify the import is successful and the transactions appear in the list.
